reconstruction.summary: Python C-API wrapper around free function H0PP_getPreClosePrice. Takes (symbol:str, date:int), creates a stack SecInfo, and returns the pre-close price as a Python float.
reconstruction.semantic_contract: getPreClosePrice(symbol: str, date: int) -> float | None
reconstruction.behavioral_notes: 1) First argument is a symbol name (Python str or bytes) converted to C char*. 2) Second argument is a date encoded as int via PyLong_AsLong. 3) On PyArg_ParseTuple failure, returns NULL with error set. 4) Underlying free function creates a stack SecInfo and delegates to SecInfo::getPreClosePrice. 5) Return value built via Py_BuildValue("d", double) using S_0010fc04.
